an8.17:1.1: [sāvatthinidānaṃ] aṭṭhahi bhikkhave ākārehi itthi purisaṃ bandhati,
an8.17:1.5: bhaṇitena bhikkhave itthi purisaṃ bandhati. gītena bhikkhave itthi purisaṃ bandhati. ruṇṇena bhikkhave itthi purisaṃ bandhati.
an8.17:1.11: imehi kho bhikkhave aṭṭhahi ākārehi itthi purisaṃ bandhati.
an8.17:1.12: te bhikkhave sattā subaddhā ye phassena baddhāti.
